findings.description: Direct inspection of the current five views and six pose renders confirms that the skirt remains too faceted, with irregular pleats and uneven/jagged hem edges. The 10 mm maximum anterior rest offset on exclusive lower front-lap vertices preserves zero movement on shared seams and slightly reduces crouch thigh-ray hits (same-side 17/18; cross-side 27/31; union 80/532), but sit metrics remain 5/266 same-side per lap and 5/6 cross-side, union 21/532. Crouch still lifts and opens the front/side panels; sit lap coverage remains incomplete. This geometric diagnostic does not establish fit tolerance.

Gray body-colored-looking patches and hard facets remain across the ivory chest and waist in current front and posed views. Their cause is not established by the renders; visible bodice surface quality remains unacceptable.

nextAction: Keep V179 rejected. The bounded anterior rest offset produced only a small crouch metric change and no sit improvement; do not increase it without a new geometry hypothesis. Rework front-lap/surrounding pattern geometry to address pose opening and silhouette while retaining V179 weight and zero shared-seam displacement; keep the bodice artifacts as a separate blocker. Re-measure crouch and sit and inspect all current renders.
